Field

Name
MobileDetectionJsonData
MobileDetectionId
ID of the mobile detection.
ContextTimeStamp
The time the event occurred on the system, as seen by the sensor. Not to be confused with timestamp which is the time the event was
received by the cloud.
CID
The customer ID. A 32-character (hex) identifier in the CrowdStrike cloud.
AID
The sensor ID. This value is unique to each installation of a Falcon sensor. When a sensor is updated or reinstalled, the host gets a new
AID. In those situations, a single host could have multiple AID values over time.
event_platform
The platform on which the sensor is running.Values: Android, iOS
app_id
The identifier of the application related to the detection, if known.
patternId
The Pattern ID associated with the detection.
ioc_type
The type of data on which the detection is based (for example "sha256").
ioc_value
The value related to the detection.(For example, a "sha256" ioc_type will have a sha256 hex string as an ioc_value, and a "domain"
ioc_type will have a domain name.)
ioc_source
The source data type for the ioc_value (for example "primary_module").
installer_info
The installer of the app, if known. Values: For apps that run inside Falcon Mobile, it will be "containerized".
